## Rule check: soft delete and error responses

The diff adds `editedAt` and `deletedAt` to `Comment`, adds soft delete to `deleteComment`, adds an edit route with `updateComment`, and caps the article list limit. I checked each rule the change touches. I did not run the tests or the migrations against a database.

### Answers to the questions

1. **What happens on delete, and which comments are listed?** Deleting sets `deletedAt` to a timestamp and keeps the row. Comments with a `deletedAt` value are left out of comment lists. Source: `policy-soft-delete`. The note `code-comment-model` says deleting removes the row, but it describes today's code, which this change replaces. I followed `policy-soft-delete`.
2. **Shape and status codes of an API error response?** Each new error response uses `{"error":{"code":"<machine_code>","message":"<text>"}}`, and HTTP status codes do not change. Source: `policy-error-response`. This conflicts with `ops-runbook.md`, which says new error responses should use the `errors` key by field. I followed `policy-error-response`, because it says it replaces the errors-by-field body and it is the rule written for new errors. The runbook's wording describes the shape that policy replaces. Support tooling reads the `errors` key, so the owner should confirm this before release.

### Rule results

| Rule (source) | Code (file:line) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Soft delete sets `deletedAt` and keeps the row (`policy-soft-delete`) | `article.service.ts:565` updates `deletedAt: new Date()` and does not call `delete` | PASS |
| Deleted comments are left out of lists (`policy-soft-delete`) | `article.service.ts:444` adds `deletedAt: null` to the comments `where` | PASS (only `getCommentsByArticle` was in the diff) |
| Only the author may delete (`policy-soft-delete`, `code-comment-ownership`) | `article.service.ts:535-537` looks up by `id` and `author.id` | PASS |
| `editedAt` is nullable (`policy-edited-at-marker`) | `schema.prisma:31` `editedAt DateTime?` | PASS |
| Existing rows are not changed by the migration (`policy-edited-at-marker`) | `20261030120000_comment_edited_at/migration.sql` adds a nullable column with no default | PASS |
| `editedAt` set on each successful edit (`policy-edited-at-marker`) | `article.service.ts:612` `editedAt: new Date()` | PASS |
| 30 minute edit window (`policy-edit-window`) | `article.service.ts:570` and `:602`, window of 30 × 60 × 1000 ms | PASS |
| Article list cap of 50, default 10 (`policy-article-list-limit`) | `article.service.ts:86` `Math.min(Number(query.limit) \|\| 10, 50)` | PASS (negative values are not covered by the rule and pass through) |
| Each migration has a one-line undo note (`policy-release-checklist`) | Both migrations start with `-- Undo:` | PASS |
| Run `npx prisma migrate deploy` on a fresh database (`policy-release-checklist`) | Not run | NOT CHECKED (no database here) |
| Tests under `app/src/tests/services` as `*.test.ts` (`code-test-layout`) | `article.service.test.ts` | PASS (not run) |

### Error path check

The diff adds three error paths in `updateComment`. Each one uses the old errors-by-field body, not the required error object from `policy-error-response`.

- **FLAG** `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:579`: 422 with `{ errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } }`. Rule: `policy-error-response` requires `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.
- **FLAG** `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:599`: 404 with `{ errors: { comment: ['not found'] } }`. Rule: same as above.
- **FLAG** `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts:603`: 403 with `{ errors: { comment: ['edit window has closed'] } }`. Rule: same as above. The status code is also not named by any rule I was given. `policy-edit-window` says the API refuses the edit but gives no code. I did not invent one. Someone needs to name the code for this refusal.

The 404 and 403 in `deleteComment` (`:551`, `:555`) and the 422s in the older code are not new in this diff, so I did not check them against the new rule.

### Notes that are now out of date

- `code-comment-model.md` says there is no `editedAt` or `deletedAt` today. The diff adds both.
- `code-migrations.md` says there are four migrations. The folder now holds six.

These are notes, not rules, so they are not flagged. They should be updated after the change is approved.

Verdict: NOT APPROVED
